title: Tech Support & Gift Card Fraud
description: Caller claims computer has dangerous malware, demands downloading AnyDesk, then demands payment via Target or Apple gift cards.

steps.text: Hello, this is the Windows Technical Support Division calling regarding urgent security breaches detected on your personal computer.
Your system is actively broadcasting Trojan malware across the network. If we do not stop this immediately, law enforcement will suspend your internet service.
Open your browser right now and install AnyDesk so our senior technician can take remote support access and clean your files.
To renew your security license and avoid arrest, you must go to Target right now and purchase a $400 Target gift card or Apple card.
